plugins.summary: Envelopes, agreements and templates in your Docusign account, through a Docusign app you create for DGC.
plugins.requirements: A Docusign developer or production account, and a Docusign app you create for DGC (DGC shows each step). A production account also needs Docusign's Go-Live review and your admin's MCP approval.
plugins.verification: Documented own-app setup implemented. Your own app's sign-in and a tool call verify access for your account.

metadata.long_summary: Envelopes, agreements and templates in your Docusign account, through a Docusign app you create for DGC. A Docusign developer or production account, and a Docusign app you create for DGC (DGC shows each step). A production account also needs Docusign's Go-Live review and your admin's MCP approval.

plugins.name: zoom
plugins.summary: Search your Zoom meetings, recordings, summaries and Docs, through a Zoom app you create for DGC.
plugins.requirements: A Zoom account in which you are the owner, an admin, or have the Zoom for developers role, and a Zoom app you create for DGC (DGC shows each step; no secret to copy). The app works for members of your own Zoom account.
plugins.verification: Documented own-app setup implemented. DGC's sign-in link reaches Zoom's own sign-in, which checks the app ID it is given. Your own app's sign-in and a tool call verify access for your account (not tested).

metadata.long_summary: Search your Zoom meetings, recordings, summaries and Docs, through a Zoom app you create for DGC. A Zoom account in which you are the owner, an admin, or have the Zoom for developers role, and a Zoom app you create for DGC (DGC shows each step; no secret to copy). The app works for members of your own Zoom account.
